| Category         | Change |    Delta |      % |              Time | Contentions |
| ---------------- | -----: | -------: | -----: | ----------------: | ----------: |
| Standard library |  +3.2% | +16.10ms | 100.0% | 505.4ms → 521.5ms |           3 |
